Name: Craftable Stardrop Tea
Author: BongWaterrr
Description:
A simple mod that allows you to cook Stardrop Tea upon reaching level 9 farming. 

The default cooking recipe is 5 Starfruit, 1 Prismatic Shard, and 1 Green Tea. 

The recipe and unlock condition is configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu, in case you feel the default recipe is too expensive.

Hope this makes reaching perfection a little easier for you! :)

Downloads.Description: - Added 2 more configurable recipes and an option to instantly unlock the recipe. In order to access these options, you have to have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
